briefing.headline: Gameweek 11 deadline is Saturday 21 Nov, 11:00 UTC, and several big names are flagged or moving in price.

points.text: The Gameweek 11 deadline is 21 November at 11:00 UTC.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro (31.2% owned) has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. He was the most sold player.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Gvardiol, Virgil, Guéhi, Belloumi and Manzambi are each listed as 75% to play. Their injuries are unspecified or minor.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Gabriel, Rice, Konsa, N.Jackson and Tavernier are rising in price. Saka, Madjo, Cook, Brooks and Schade are falling.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: N.Jackson, Evanilson, Barry, Van Hecke and Vuskovic are the most bought players. Jackson is also a popular captain pick.
